data.title: wf: returns state a design review (t416u)

data.text:
Goal: a return for a pass packed on template 4 must carry a filled design review line, naming the design files the builder compared its work against; wf refuses the return without it, naming t416u. Band door: 90.50.10.0400.
Lab: 90.50.10.0701 (wf loop lab, lab band 0700); trial file tests/lab_0404.rs.
Done when: cargo test --lib passes on the box; the lab's trial tests/lab_0404.rs passes on the box (a v4 return with no line is refused naming t416u and recorded; one with the line is accepted); cargo test --test wf still passes; a pass packed on template 1, 2 or 3 (such as 0403.05.01) prints and checks exactly as before.

Read before draft 05.01: face 04 is empty, there was no earlier face 06, and there is no closed 05. Matthew's words t461u let the core make pages for now, to prove the loop (docs/review/DIRECTOR-WORDS-t461u.md on prima/build at eab22702). Prima typed init-page with --as matthew, because wf requires --as to match --person (src/cmd.rs:190 at c09fa60c). The grant ref is t461u. Pack text refreshed from docs/design/drafts/90.50.10/PACK-0404-v3.md. Start origin/returns 3646e344, the landing of 0701.05.01. Lab is 90.50.10.0701. Slot 0497 stays unused. Template version is still 3 at src/render.rs:29; this pass makes template 4. This note is the one a draft requires (src/cmd.rs:297-298).

fields.overview: Band 90.50.10.04xx, door 90.50.10.0400 (its face 01 lists this job). Lab: 90.50.10.0701, the wf loop lab in the lab band 0700 (t432.md:16 "The labs should be a separate page in it's own band."); its trial for this page is tests/lab_0404.rs, written by another view after this return (t425u.md:3 "each page should be linked to the test lab for it"). This page writes no test file and copies no harness. Why: t416u.md:7 "Novel work requires additional reviews against design documents for alignement.  Must be confirmed before the return is complete.  We can't force it but we can force it to confirm it did this via our WF"; t424.md:10 "All Workshop work counts as novel for now". wf cannot prove the review happened; it can make the builder state it. Rule files never change under an open pass (t381u.md:8), so old packs keep their template. Code re-read at origin/returns 3646e344 (0701.05.01 landing; src/ matches the corrected c09fa60c cites): RETURN_KEYS src/cmd.rs:15; parse_return src/cmd.rs:467 (body 467-482); ret src/cmd.rs:484; return-refused src/cmd.rs:515; pack entry records templates at src/cmd.rs:405; TEMPLATE_VER src/render.rs:29 is still 3; packed_templates src/render.rs:37-51; grant check src/cmd.rs:371. The five hand-written return strings already carry the design review line, now at tests/common/mod.rs:93 and tests/wf.rs:713, :851, :1438, :1648. This page still writes no test file. Axioms: 1.7.8 is the cold set before a write (Axioms.md:9); then 5 Frame (the design files are the frame), 9 Trial (the review is stated so another view can try it), 4 Why (the builder records what it compared).
fields.stop if: another file must change; a test file seems needed (the lab writes it; say what it should try in overflow); a pass packed before this change would print or check differently; a rule above reads two ways
fields.w01: new templates/v4/return.txt: the text of templates/return.txt with one line added after the proof line and before the not done line: "design review: <the design files you compared your work against (at least docs/AXIOMS.md and docs/DESIGN.md in the kit), what matched, and any place it differs; t416u>". In src/render.rs add T_RETURN_V4 from that file, set TEMPLATE_VER to "4", and make packed_templates return (T_AGENTS_V3, T_PROMPT_V3, T_RETURN_V4) for "4". Leave "1", "2" and "3" exactly as they are. Update the render.rs unit tests that name the version.
fields.w02: in src/cmd.rs, when the pass's pack entry has templates "4", parse_return also requires a filled "design review" line (present, not empty, not starting with "<"). The refusal says: "the return has no 'design review:' line filled in. t416u: novel work is reviewed against the design documents before the return is complete". It is recorded as return-refused like the other refusals. Packs on templates 1, 2 or 3 do not need the line. Unit tests in src/cmd.rs's own test module: a v4 pass without the line is refused with that message; with it, passes; a v3 pass without it passes.
